headline: Pennsylvania would let Attorney General enforce data center bans
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would give the Attorney General the power to enforce bans on data centers being developed or operated by certain foreign entities. Not passed.

170 measures in 40 jurisdictions would require a label, watermark, or disclosure on AI content, or a notice to the people AI is used on.

90 measures in 29 jurisdictions cite the fear that data centers are taking the power and the water.

2,245 measures tracked. 755 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
